data.narrative:
GRU is a private-stage company in Space & Aerospace founded by Skyler Chan. The sector comparison universe comprises 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Two standard valuation triangulation methods are not applicable here. Peer-median analysis fails due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables: while 14 same-sector peers exist in Space & Aerospace, filtering by stage and valuation tier yields fewer than three datapoints, making a reliable median unrepresentative. Public-comp anchoring via EV/Revenue multiple cannot be deployed because GRU's revenue is not on file—standard practice for private companies. The Space & Aerospace public cohort trades at a 27.4x P/S median across the five tickers, but applying this multiple requires the target's top-line, which is unavailable.

Without disclosed financials or a sufficiently dense peer cluster at GRU's stage and valuation tier, traditional quantitative anchors do not support a single valuation point estimate or range. Any credible analysis would require either (1) GRU's revenue or comparable SaaS/services metrics, (2) access to recent private transaction pricing within its specific subsector and stage, or (3) disclosure of current valuation and capital raise to enable implied-return analysis. Present data constraints preclude numerical synthesis.
